videoInfo.title: Beauty and the Beast: The Curse | Episodes 1-3 | Little Fox
videoInfo.purpose: 兒童英語學習，影片播放時老師展示對應詞彙與例句

wordSegments.englishSentence: Two years passed.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 兩年過去了。

wordSegments.englishSentence: Beauty made the cottage a home. She made curtains.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 貝兒把小屋變成家。她做了窗簾。

wordSegments.englishSentence: She planted a garden.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 她開闢了一座花園。

wordSegments.englishSentence: Beauty loved cooking. But she loved her flowers best of all.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 貝兒喜歡烹飪。但她最愛她的花。

wordSegments.englishSentence: Her favorite was a small rose bush.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 她最喜歡的是一小叢玫瑰。

wordSegments.englishSentence: One day, Beauty was in the garden. Her roses were ready to bloom.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 有一天，貝兒在花園裡。她的玫瑰準備要開花了。

wordSegments.englishSentence: Father came outside and sat down. He looks so tired, Beauty thought.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 爸爸走到外面坐下。貝兒心想，他看起來好疲倦。

wordSegments.englishSentence: You should go live in town. A young girl needs friends.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 你應該搬到鎮上住。年輕女孩需要朋友。

wordSegments.englishSentence: "But I do have friends," Beauty said.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 貝兒說：「可是我有朋友。」

wordSegments.englishSentence: Father was surprised.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 爸爸很驚訝。

wordSegments.englishSentence: "Who?" Beauty pointed to the edge of the forest.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 「誰？」貝兒指向森林邊緣。

wordSegments.englishSentence: A deer stood watching them. Her big brown eyes were soft and gentle.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 一隻鹿站著看著他們。牠大大的棕色眼睛溫柔又柔和。

wordSegments.englishSentence: Father laughed. You're very funny, beauty. I'm going fishing.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 爸爸笑了。貝兒，你真有趣。我要去釣魚。

wordSegments.englishSentence: I'll try to catch us some dinner.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 我試著抓點東西當我們的晚餐。

wordSegments.englishSentence: Father thinks I'm joking, Beauty thought. But the deer was her friend.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 貝兒心想，爸爸以為我在開玩笑，但這隻鹿是她的朋友。

wordSegments.englishSentence: Sometimes she brought beauty fruit.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 有時候牠會帶水果給貝兒。

wordSegments.englishSentence: Other times she brought flowers.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 其他時候牠會帶花。

wordSegments.englishSentence: Beauty gave the deer food from her garden.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 貝兒給鹿吃她花園裡種的食物。

wordSegments.englishSentence: Beauty went over to the deer. Did you bring me something today?
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 貝兒走向鹿。你今天有帶東西給我嗎？

wordSegments.englishSentence: The deer shook her head. That's okay, Beauty said.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 鹿搖搖頭。貝兒說：「沒關係。」

wordSegments.englishSentence: I'm happy to see you. Beauty stroked the deer's nose.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 很高興見到你。貝兒輕撫鹿的鼻子。

wordSegments.englishSentence: The deer gently pushed Beauty's hand. Then she nodded toward the forest.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 鹿輕輕推了推貝兒的手，接著朝森林點頭。

wordSegments.englishSentence: "You want me to follow you?" The deer nodded. Beauty smiled.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 「你想要我跟著你嗎？」鹿點點頭。貝兒笑了。

wordSegments.englishSentence: It seemed like the deer wanted to show her something.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 看起來鹿想要展示某樣東西給她看。

wordSegments.englishSentence: She wanted to go, but father always warned her.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 她很想去，但是爸爸總是警告她。

wordSegments.englishSentence: The forest is cursed. A monster lives there.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 這片森林被下了詛咒。有一隻怪獸住在那裡。

wordSegments.englishSentence: I'm sorry. I can't go.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 對不起，我不能去。

wordSegments.englishSentence: Suddenly father came running. He was jumping for joy.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 突然爸爸跑過來，他高興得跳起來。

wordSegments.englishSentence: I have the best news. Finally, my ship came in.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 我有最好的消息！我的船終於抵港了。

wordSegments.englishSentence: Once upon another time, there was a girl named Beauty.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 從前，有一個名叫貝兒的女孩。

wordSegments.englishSentence: She lived above her father's shop. He sold fine cloth from far away lands.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 她住在爸爸的店鋪樓上。爸爸販售來自遙遠國度的精美布料。

wordSegments.englishSentence: Beauty helped father in the shop.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 貝兒在店裡幫爸爸的忙。

wordSegments.englishSentence: One day the shelves were bare. "Father," Beauty said. "Where's our cloth?"
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 有一天架子上空空如也。貝兒說：「爸爸，我們的布料在哪？」

wordSegments.englishSentence: The ship carrying it is lost at sea.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 載著布料的船在海上失蹤了。

wordSegments.englishSentence: Later, Beauty was working alone. The sheriff came in.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 後來，貝兒獨自工作，警長走了進來。

wordSegments.englishSentence: "Where's your father?" "He's at the dock," Beauty said.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 「你爸爸在哪？」貝兒說：「他在碼頭。」

wordSegments.englishSentence: "May I help you?" The sheriff scowlled. He owes money to everyone in town.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 「我可以幫你嗎？」警長皺起眉頭。他欠鎮上所有人錢。

wordSegments.englishSentence: If he doesn't pay, I'll put him in jail.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 如果他不還錢，我就要把他關進監牢。

wordSegments.englishSentence: The sheriff crossed his arms. He has two months or jail.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 警長交叉手臂。他有兩個月時間，否則就要坐牢。

wordSegments.englishSentence: When father returned, beauty rushed toward him. Did the ship arrive?
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 爸爸回來時，貝兒奔向他。船抵達了嗎？

wordSegments.englishSentence: Oh, maybe tomorrow. Weeks passed.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 噢，也許明天。幾個禮拜過去了。

wordSegments.englishSentence: The ship still didn't arrive. Father grew more worried.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 船仍然沒有抵達。爸爸越來越擔心。

wordSegments.englishSentence: Beauty, you deserve a better life.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 貝兒，你值得更好的生活。

wordSegments.englishSentence: Go stay with your sister. She married a rich man.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 去和你姐姐住。她嫁給了有錢人。

wordSegments.englishSentence: "I'm staying here," she said.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 她說：「我要留在這裡。」

wordSegments.englishSentence: Then one day a letter came.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 然後有一天，一封信送來了。

wordSegments.englishSentence: Oh no, father cried. The ship sank. We lost everything.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 爸爸大喊：「噢不！船沉了。我們失去所有東西。」

wordSegments.englishSentence: That's awful. Beauty said. Father made a plan.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 貝兒說：「太糟糕了。」爸爸擬定一個計畫。

wordSegments.englishSentence: I'll go to my cottage in the forest. The sheriff won't find me there.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 我要去森林裡我的小屋。警長在那裡找不到我。

wordSegments.englishSentence: He looked at beauty. The forest is cursed.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 他看著貝兒。這片森林被下了詛咒。

wordSegments.englishSentence: The wood cutters say a monster lives there now. You'll stay with your sister.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 樵夫說現在有怪獸住在那裡。你要和姐姐一起住。

wordSegments.englishSentence: A monster. Beauty laughed. Nonsense.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 怪獸？貝兒笑了。胡說八道。

wordSegments.englishSentence: I'm coming with you, father. He sighed.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 爸爸，我跟你一起去。他嘆了一口氣。

wordSegments.englishSentence: Fine.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 好吧。

wordSegments.englishSentence: That night, Beauty and Father went to the cottage.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 那天晚上，貝兒和爸爸前往小屋。

wordSegments.englishSentence: It was small and dark, but beauty looked around and smiled.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 小屋又小又暗，但貝兒環顧四周並笑了。

wordSegments.englishSentence: Looks aren't everything. I like it here.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 外表不是一切。我喜歡這裡。

wordSegments.englishSentence: Once upon a time there was a queen. She was very kind.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 從前有一位王后。她非常善良。

wordSegments.englishSentence: But her son was unkind. The queen gave people food. She helped the poor.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 但是她的兒子很不友善。王后給人食物，幫助窮人。

wordSegments.englishSentence: The prince sent them away.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 王子把他們趕走。

wordSegments.englishSentence: One day, a fairy was passing the castle.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 有一天，一位仙女經過城堡。

wordSegments.englishSentence: A man was asking the prince for help. Please, sir, I need shelter.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 一名男子向王子求助。拜託先生，我需要避難處。

wordSegments.englishSentence: Then build a house. The prince snapped. Can you give me a few coins?
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 王子厲聲說：「那就自己蓋房子。」你可以給我幾枚硬幣嗎？

wordSegments.englishSentence: Never. The prince said. Fairy shook her head.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 王子說：「絕對不行。」仙女搖搖頭。

wordSegments.englishSentence: I know he lost his princess, she thought. But I must teach him to be loving again.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 她心想：我知道他失去了公主，但我必須教他再次學會愛人。

wordSegments.englishSentence: Poof. The fairy turned into an old woman.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 噗！仙女變成一位老婦人。

wordSegments.englishSentence: She went up to the prince. Please, sir. I am hungry.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 她走向王子。拜託先生，我很餓。

wordSegments.englishSentence: Then buy some food, the prince said. The woman pulled out a rose.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 王子說：「那就自己買食物。」老婦人拿出一朵玫瑰。

wordSegments.englishSentence: I'll pay you with this.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 我用這個付給你。

wordSegments.englishSentence: I don't want that, the prince said. Then I'll use magic.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 王子說：「我不要那個。」那我就要使用魔法了。

wordSegments.englishSentence: She waved her wand. Poof. I've cursed everyone in your castle.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 她揮動魔杖。噗！我詛咒了你城堡裡所有人。

wordSegments.englishSentence: The forest is cursed, too. What? The prince was confused.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 森林也被詛咒了。什麼？王子感到困惑。

wordSegments.englishSentence: The fairy lifted her wand again. Now it's your turn.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 仙女再次舉起魔杖。現在輪到你了。

wordSegments.englishSentence: You'll look as beastly as you act.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 你的樣子會變得和你的行為一樣殘暴。

wordSegments.englishSentence: The prince turned into a terrible beast. Fairy smiled.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 王子變成一隻可怕的野獸。仙女笑了。

wordSegments.englishSentence: Perfect. I put my curse on you. Now you're as ugly as your heart.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 很好。我將詛咒施加於你。現在你的樣子和內心一樣醜陋。

wordSegments.englishSentence: The prince looked down. He had sharp claws and dark fur.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 王子往下看。他長出尖銳的爪子與深色毛皮。

wordSegments.englishSentence: His ring seemed to glow with magic. Turn me back into a prince.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 他的戒指似乎閃著魔法光芒。把我變回王子。

wordSegments.englishSentence: He roared. Fairy shook her head and handed him the rose.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 他咆哮。仙女搖搖頭，把玫瑰遞給他。

wordSegments.englishSentence: Only love can break my curse. Find true love before the rose's last petal falls.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 只有愛能解除我的詛咒。在玫瑰最後一片花瓣掉落前找到真愛。

wordSegments.englishSentence: I have been trapped in this beastly form for years, hiding away from the world.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 我被困在這野獸的模樣許多年，躲離這個世界。
